label: No non-INFINITE_1 intellect COMPREHEND_2s an INFINITE_1 being
paraphrase: Derived conditional bridge (its premises remain open), analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For every g and x: if g is INFINITE_1, x has intellect (HAS_INTELLECT_1) and x is not INFINITE_1, then x does not COMPREHEND_2 g (ComprehendsByMeasure, definition 1218cc1e: x knows g at no degree that reaches g's knowability). The COMPREHEND_2 sibling of 'No intellect that is not INFINITE_1 comprehends an INFINITE_1 being' (COMPREHEND_1). Derived (finiteIntellectDoesNotComprehend2Infinite) from maximal knowability of the INFINITE_1 and the non-maximal power of non-INFINITE_1 intellects by transitivity of the order: from knowability g <= d <= p with knowability g maximal, p would be maximal. It says nothing about whether x knows g truly (q.12 a.7 ad 1) and allows g to COMPREHEND_2 itself (Control part 1).
